title: The Rally Calls
style: world jazz, female lead vocal, brass and kora blend, upbeat 94 BPM, call and response, multilingual pickleball coaching anthem, choir on chorus, longer than 2 mins
lyrics:
[INTRO]
(spoken)
Every court. Every country.
The rally starts the same way.

[VERSE 1 - English]
Move your feet, get to the ball
Watch the paddle, read the call
Stay low, bend the knees
Control the rally with ease

[VERSE 2 - Tagalog transliteration]
Galaw ang paa, abutin ang bola
Panoorin ang pala, basahin ang tawag
Manatiling mababa, yumuko ang tuhod
Kontroling ang rally nang may ginhawa

[VERSE 3 - Amharic transliteration]
Egirih yasazil, bolawn atrik
Padilun tiy, tigruw awik
Tik bel, gulbetih kefet
Rallyin fit moltew awik

[CHORUS]
RALLY - RALLY - TAWAG - TAWAG
MOVE YOUR FEET - STAY LOW - HOLD YOUR LINE
RALLY - RALLY - EVERY COURT
CALL AND RESPONSE - EVERY TIME

[VERSE 4 - Bengali transliteration]
Paa chalao, ball er kache jao
Paddle dekho, call bujho
Nichu thako, hatu bako
Rally ke niyantran koro

[VERSE 5 - Ukrainian transliteration]
Rukhai nohy, dosiahny myacha
Slidkui za raketkoiu, chytai krychku
Zalyshaisya nyzko, zihny kolina
Kontroliui ralli lehko

[VERSE 6 - Malay]
Gerakkan kaki, capai bola
Tonton raket, baca panggilan
Rendah duduk, lutut bengkok
Kawal rali dengan mudah

[CHORUS]
RALLY - RALLY - TAWAG - TAWAG
MOVE YOUR FEET - STAY LOW - HOLD YOUR LINE
RALLY - RALLY - EVERY COURT
CALL AND RESPONSE - EVERY TIME

[BRIDGE - spoken]
(coach voice)
In every language,
Move. Bend. Watch. Control.
The rally is yours if you want it.

[FINAL CHORUS]
RALLY - RALLY - TAWAG - TAWAG
MOVE YOUR FEET - STAY LOW - HOLD YOUR LINE
RALLY - RALLY - EVERY COURT
CALL AND RESPONSE - EVERY TIME
ONE GAME - EVERY LANGUAGE - HOLD YOUR LINE

[OUTRO]
Every court. Every call.
Rally on.
